CollatzBandBridge.family_first_return_descent (r : ℕ) :
  CollatzShell.ForwardSection.next (CollatzBandBridge.familyInput r) < CollatzBandBridge.familyInput r
CollatzBandBridge.unbounded_descending_first_returns (B : ℕ) :
  ∃ n, B < n ∧ CollatzShell.ForwardSection.Marked n ∧ CollatzShell.ForwardSection.next n < n
CollatzShell.ForwardSection.MarkFrequency.marked_visits_density_zero (n : ℕ) (hn : n % 2 = 1)
  (hinj : Function.Injective (CollatzShell.ForwardSection.oddOrbit n)) (ε : ℝ) :
  0 < ε → ∃ N₀, ∀ N ≥ N₀, ↑(CollatzShell.ForwardSection.MarkFrequency.markedVisits n N) < ε * ↑N
CollatzShell.ForwardSection.ReturnFourier.ordinary_odd_fourier_limit (n k : ℕ) (hn : n % 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k)
  (hinj : Function.Injective (CollatzShell.ForwardSection.oddOrbit n)) (ε : ℝ) :
  0 < ε →
    ∃ N₀,
      ∀ (N : ℕ),
        N₀ ≤ N →
          ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
                CollatzShell.ForwardSection.ReturnFourier.character k
                  (CollatzShell.ForwardSection.height (CollatzShell.ForwardSection.oddOrbit n j))‖ <
            ε * ↑N
CollatzBandDescent.unbounded_missing_offset_prefix (B : ℕ) :
  ∃ n,
    B < n ∧ CollatzShell.ForwardSection.Marked n ∧ ∀ t ≤ n.log2, n - 2 ^ n.log2 ≤ CollatzShell.orbit t (n - 2 ^ n.log2)
CollatzShell.BandSimulation.ordinary_marked_simulation (L K M : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) :
  ∃ n,
    M < n ∧
      CollatzShell.ForwardSection.Marked n ∧
        ∀ j ≤ L, n ≤ CollatzShell.orbit j n ∧ CollatzShell.orbit j n % 2 = 1 ∧ 2 ^ K ∣ CollatzShell.orbit j n + 1
